title: OneCoin Webinar - 31.03.2016
description: OneCoin Webinar hosted by Paul Smith - 31.03.2016.

asr.full_text: Hello and a warm welcome to all of you from myself Paul Smith to this week's State of the Nation broadcasted for the 31st of March of 2016. As we break through 1.75 million members the business goes from strength to strength thanks to each and every one of you as you build your futures with OneCoin. As you all know the Festival package is no longer available. Instead, OneCoin is offering you an exceptional opportunity, the Infinity Trader package. If you choose the Infinity Plus option within the package you'll get up to seven splits and will be able to significantly increase your tokens and in turn, your coins. We're even offering a special Infinity promotion. If you bank 8 codes, you'll get one free Infinity Code. Over the past few weeks, one of our most successful products, the OneCoin Cloud, has marked record sales. More and more people are taking advantage of the unique cloud-based offer for users who are looking for a storage solution with client-side encryption functionality. This increase comes following the recent improvements and upgrades to packages which you can download for Windows, OS X, Android, and iOS from our website. All OneCoin cloud packages provide military level protection for your data since only the user can lock and unlock files.In one simple brilliant app both businesses and private persons get the opportunity to store files securely and privately browse the Internet from any location in the world. One coin cloud provides additional storage on your computer or mobile device where you can store access and manage your most important sensitive files at any one moment. Most members opt to purchase the best option the OneCoin Cloud Plus which we would also recommend, it gives you an astounding 100 gigabytes of encrypted and storage, client side encryption with zero knowledge privacy, a highly secured browser, and a VPN connection for a year. Additionally, you receive 3000 tokens free. Visit our website now to find out more about the unique OneCoin Cloud offers and guarantee your file security. CoinSafe is your chance to take advantage of an opportunity no other company is able to offer. OneCoin was established with the purpose of revolutionising the world of finances by offering unique opportunities to its clients. coinSafes gives you the chance to also earn a deposit rate on the balance of your coins besides what you earn from the rising value of the oneCoin currency. To find out more about coinSafe, why't you let our leaders tell you all about it. Go to our Youtube videos and learn more. On Thursday March 24th Dr. Roosia Ignatova hosted a special webinar in which she gave the latest exciting updates about OneCoin our new promotions, the Infinity package and Onecoins global event in London. If you missed the webinar don't worry you can watch it again and keep up with all the latest updates. Check our website or visit the One Coin Webinar's YouTube channel or onecoin.soth.com website for more information. As I said in the opening, we now have a global member and customer base that has passed £1.75 million in what is still only a business just reaching 18 months of operations. Onecoin's global goal is to empower billions of people by providing borderless, low-cost financial transactions and connecting them to the financial world To plug the unbanked into the financial network With a powerful vision, strong leadership and a clear strategy Our vision is to grant access to financial services to everyone By providing education and simplifying and demystifying cryptocurrency. And that vision is resonating around the world. As announced in Dr Ruzsa's special State of the Nation last week, OneCoin is holding a global event in London on the 11th of June. It s going to be AWESOME. You just HAVE to be there. That European tour is about to go to Kazakhstan, and on the 9th of April it features our CEO and founder, Dr Ruza Ignatova. The event is part of a series of presentations on OneCoin held in Astana and Ultimae between the 5th and 9th of April this year. See this week's newsletter on how to book an event. In addition, Kari Walrus is in Amsterdam, Netherlands on the 2nd of April and Warsaw Poland on the 3rd. A reminder of our current promotions. The new and exciting eight plus one infinity if you bank eight infinity codes you'll get one infinity code free, the 10 plus one premium if you bank 10 premium codes you'll get one premium code free, the 10 plus one tycoon if you bank 10 tycoon codes you'll get one tycoon code free the sixth premium and three pro trader if you bank 10 Tycoon Codes you'll get 1 Tycoon Code free The 6th Premium and 3rd Pro Trader If you bank 6 Premium Codes, you'll get 3 Pro Trader Code free And of course the 6 Plus 1 Champions This coin coi Vegas promotion related only to its top package gives you one extra Champions Code if you bank in six champion codes. One World Foundation is proud to announce that it's launched its new YouTube channel. Here we'll show you first-hand how we empower children to reach their potential through education and long-term support. Help us spread the word by liking and sharing. We thank you. Follow One World Foundation and it's projects on the ONEWORLDFROUNDATION website and the One World Foundation Facebook page and now the One World Foundation YouTube channel. That concludes this week State of the Nation. I'll be back on the 7th of April, our first in the month, same time. Talk to you then, and the very best for your businesses.

textual.observation: The webinar promotes CoinSafe as providing a deposit rate on coin balances in addition to gains stated to come from the currency's rising value, and directs viewers to learn more through leaders' YouTube videos.

evidence.quote: coinSafes gives you the chance to also earn a deposit rate on the balance of your coins besides what you earn from the rising value of the oneCoin currency.
To find out more about coinSafe, why't you let our leaders tell you all about it. Go to our Youtube videos and learn more.

textual.context: Presented by the webinar speaker as a promotional description of a OneCoin-related offering; the records do not independently establish the terms or outcomes.
textual.potential_relevance: A stated return on coin balances and stated gains from currency value are connected to a call to seek more information about the offering.
textual.limitations: The records do not state deposit requirements, rates, duration, recipient accounts, whether viewers acted, or whether any return was received.

textual.observation: The webinar says purchasers of OneCoin Cloud Plus receive 3000 tokens free and asks viewers to visit the website for the offer.

evidence.quote: Most members opt to purchase the best option the OneCoin Cloud Plus which we would also recommend, it gives you an astounding 100 gigabytes of encrypted and storage, client side encryption with zero knowledge privacy, a highly secured browser, and a VPN connection for a year. Additionally, you receive 3000 tokens free.
Visit our website now to find out more about the unique OneCoin Cloud offers and guarantee your file security.

textual.context: The speaker presents this as a commercial product offer and recommendation; the supplied records do not show the website, purchase flow, or token terms.
textual.potential_relevance: A stated token reward is tied to purchasing a named package, with viewers directed to an external website for details.
textual.limitations: The records do not provide the package price, token value, eligibility conditions, website contents, or evidence that a purchase or token transfer occurred.

textual.observation: The webinar advertises free additional codes when viewers "bank" specified quantities of Infinity, Premium, or Tycoon codes.

evidence.quote: The new and exciting eight plus one infinity if you bank eight infinity codes you'll get one infinity code free, the 10 plus one premium if you bank 10 premium codes you'll get one premium code free, the 10 plus one tycoon if you bank 10 tycoon codes you'll get one tycoon code free

textual.context: Presented as a reminder of current promotions. The exact meaning of "bank" and the offer conditions are not explained in the supplied records.
textual.potential_relevance: The stated free-code rewards are explicitly conditional on viewers banking specified quantities of codes.
textual.limitations: The records do not define the codes, explain how they are obtained or banked, give their value, state full conditions, or show whether anyone participated.

visual.observation: A promotional slide states that choosing the "Infinity+" option provides up to 7 splits intended to increase Tokens and, in turn, coins; it also states, "Bank 8 Codes and get 1 free."
visual.context: Visible promotional presentation for OneCoin's "Infinity Trader package."
visual.potential_relevance: The slide links a stated package-selection action and banking eight codes to free code(s), while also presenting token and coin increases as a package benefit.
visual.limitations: The sampled frame does not show the price, full terms, how codes are obtained or banked, whether viewers can complete the action, or any resulting value.

visual.observation: A promotional slide says that purchasing the "OneCoinCloud plus" option includes "3000 Tokens FREE," alongside listed cloud-storage, encryption, browser, and VPN features.
visual.context: Visible promotional presentation for an upgraded OneCoinCloud product option.
visual.potential_relevance: The stated free-token reward is explicitly attached to purchasing the Plus option.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show the purchase price, full eligibility or redemption terms, token value, payment process, or whether the offer was available.

visual.observation: A "Current Promotions" slide lists several offers in which banking specified quantities of named codes results in free additional codes or "3 Pro Trader codes."
visual.context: Visible promotional presentation; examples include banking 8 Infinity codes for 1 Infinity code free and banking 10 Premium codes for 1 Premium code free.
visual.potential_relevance: The slide repeatedly links the requested banking of specified code quantities to stated free-code rewards under defined numerical conditions.
visual.limitations: The frame does not establish what banking entails, how the codes are acquired, the offers' full conditions, their value, or any completed transaction.

visual_context_notes.observation: The relevant slides are visually labeled as "PROMOTIONS" and present OneCoin-branded package and code offers.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because its presenter promotes the OneCoin Infinity Trader package with claims that Infinity+ can significantly increase tokens and coins, while soliciting viewers to bank codes for a free-code reward. It also connects CoinSafe deposit rates and gains attributed to rising currency values with further information about the offering, alongside a Cloud Plus purchase incentive, although the records do not establish prices, complete terms, completed transactions, or resulting value.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central package promotion links participation in a priced Infinity Trader package to increasing tokens and coins; the speaker also describes gains from a rising coin value. Separately, the speaker promotes CoinSafe as a way to earn a deposit rate on coin balances, supporting S03.

evidence.observation: The speaker links an Infinity package option to an increase in tokens and coins.
evidence.quote: If you choose the Infinity Plus option within the package you'll get up to seven splits and will be able to significantly increase your tokens and in turn, your coins.

evidence.observation: An Infinity Trader package slide displays a €25 000 figure and says the Infinity+ option offers up to seven splits that increase tokens and coins.
The speaker claims a deposit rate on coin balances and gains from a rising coin value.
evidence.quote: coinSafes gives you the chance to also earn a deposit rate on the balance of your coins besides what you earn from the rising value of the oneCoin currency.

evidence.observation: The stated promotion awards a free code for banking eight codes; this statement does not describe recruitment.
evidence.quote: If you bank 8 codes, you'll get one free Infinity Code.
